game.q: word of the insult reaches guru angad. what does he do?
opts: turns the insult into an honor
tells amar das to take a day off

wrong.rest: kind, but no. he did something bigger.

game.right: YES. “he is not homeless. he is the home of the homeless.”

end.line: an old man carried water before dawn for years. they mocked him. he became the third guru.
end.l2: he was the home of the homeless.
